name: generated-page-registration
goal: Register the generated initial page screenshot cases and scenario without inventing reviewed evidence.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: A fresh generated app emits three initial-page screenshot cases but no page unit testing contract or scenario references, leaving all three cases orphaned.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing app project template case checked emitted screenshots and static discovery but did not validate the page manifest or scenario against those exact cases. Strengthen that case without adding a test title.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test-only 7a0914c4d3 strengthened the existing app template case; Harness red records its missing page contract as an actual product failure.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Source-only 5bd1842794 registers the three existing page cases, their scenario and strict unit policy, and declares the build and cache paths without adding screenshot bytes.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged app template case passed Harness green 5bd0d4ff6384 at 5bd1842794 under the red command and environment.

steps.title: Reject and restore missing generated page registration.
steps.evidence: Original generator mutant f8a3cd089c failed capture 801f5f6929e8 on the missing contract; restored aade78d515 passed daf51a18ab74 with the same complete tree as 5bd1842794.

steps.title: Retain source and focused workload observations.
steps.evidence: At 5bd1842794, project template bytes/lines/complexity/dependencies were 8203/223/10/11 and project tests 9003/217/12/5; both are modules without separate artifacts. Focused capture 4517c32403e1 retains timing and whole-worker RSS.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
